title: Externally save file, focus Godot with open dialog, Error: Attempting to make child window exclusive
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev7.official [c971f93e7]
v4.7.2.stable.official [ed1daf0bf]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev7 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (853x683 @ 60.02 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Modifying and saving a scene file externally, and focusing Godot when it has a dialog open:
>  ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:1209 - Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child. This window: /root/@EditorNode@20503/@Panel@14/@ConfirmationDialog@9869, parent window: /root, current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode@20503/@Panel@14/@EditorFileDialog@8862


### Steps to reproduce

- create a new project
- in the scene panel, click: 2d scene
- save the scene with the default name: node2d.tscn
- open a dialog, ex: Editor > Command palette...
- in an external text editor, open the scene file: node2d.tscn
- add a new blank line, and save
- focus Godot
- a dialog appears: Files have been modified outside Godot

### Issue
Close the dialogs and open the output panel to see the message:
>  ERROR: scene/main/window.cpp:1209 - Attempting to make child window exclusive, but the parent window already has another exclusive child. This window: /root/@EditorNode@20503/@Panel@14/@ConfirmationDialog@9869, parent window: /root, current exclusive child window: /root/@EditorNode@20503/@Panel@14/@EditorFileDialog@8862
